name: Retinal Images Benchmark for DR and CSME
description: A dataset and evaluation protocol for detecting diabetic retinopathy and clinically significant macular edema (CSME) from retinal images.
evaluation_method: AUC (ROC) and sensitivity/specificity (often reported alongside F1)
reputation: Recognized within ophthalmic imaging research for benchmarking DR and CSME detection, but less ubiquitous than some larger public retinal datasets (e.g., EyePACS).
notes: Medical imaging benchmark (non-LLM); label quality and prevalence can vary by site/population; dataset sizes may be moderate and class imbalance is common.
